title: Metrovpn v2.7.7 Auto-Updater, QR Share & License Compliance
message: Fixes the Windows auto-updater for NSIS, MSI, and Standalone EXE builds (releases the single-instance mutex, waits for clean process exit, verifies PE/MSI magic headers and SHA-256 checksums, and supports UAC/ShellExecute handoff), replaces the broken Share Node QR placeholder with a real scannable ISO/IEC 18004 QR generator with PNG export, fixes active-node deletion, node edit URI sync, subscription proxy routing, and Xray config edge cases, and bundles full MIT / MPL-2.0 / GPL-3.0 / Wintun open-source licenses and notices.
